title: Geography.
description: Analyse complex physical and human processes shaping our world, supported by case studies, fieldwork and synoptic evaluation skills.

sections.title: Water and Carbon Cycles
sections.text: Global systems and processes, drainage basins, climate regulation and human impacts on carbon storage.

sections.title: Coastal and Glacial Landscapes
sections.text: Advanced geomorphology, sediment budgets, landform development and management strategies.

sections.title: Hazards
sections.text: Tectonic and weather hazards, risk management, vulnerability and governance responses.

sections.title: Globalisation
sections.text: Economic integration, trade flows, global governance and impacts on development.

sections.title: Changing Places
sections.text: Place identity, regeneration, inequality and lived experience.

sections.title: Population and Environment
sections.text: Demographic transition, migration, urbanisation and sustainability challenges.

sections.title: Fieldwork Investigation (NEA)
sections.text: Independent enquiry worth 20%, including hypothesis design, data collection, statistical testing and critical evaluation.

sections.title: Synoptic Skills
sections.text: Applying knowledge across themes, evaluating geographical issues and constructing extended 20-mark essays.
